fato_historico: 1963: U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson establishes the Warren Commission to investigate the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to seek clarity and truth today. Much like uncovering hidden pieces of a larger puzzle, you may find that looking deeper into your personal narratives brings peace. It is a good time to release past burdens and step forward with newfound resolve, trusting that your radiant Aries spirit will guide you through any confusion.
frase_do_dia: Truth is the compass that guides your heart toward a brighter tomorrow.
significado_numero: Representing the union of intuition and the strength of the collective.
conselho: Consider slowing down to examine your goals with a fresh and honest perspective.
